sn35.87:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn35.87:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca sārīputto āyasmā ca mahācundo āyasmā ca channo gijjhakūṭe pabbate viharanti.
sn35.87:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā channo ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
sn35.87:1.4: atha kho āyasmā sārīputto sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā mahācundo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahācundaṃ etadavoca
sn35.87:1.5: āyāmāvuso cunda yenāyasmā channo tenupasaṅkamissāma gilānapucchakāti.
sn35.87:1.6: evamāvusoti kho āyasmā mahācundo āyasmato sārīputtassa paccassosi.
sn35.87:2.1: atha kho āyasmā ca sārīputto āyasmā ca mahācundo yenāyasmā channo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdiṃsu. nisajja kho āyasmā sārīputto āyasmantaṃ channaṃ etadavoca
sn35.87:2.2: kacci te āvuso channa khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyaṃ kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamoti.
sn35.87:3.1: na me āvuso sārīputta khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti abhikkamo sānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamoti.
sn35.87:3.2: seyyathāpi āvuso balavā puriso tiṇhena sikharena muddhanaṃ abhimattheyya evameva kho me āvuso adhimattā vātā muddhani upahananti.
sn35.87:3.3: na me āvuso khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ …pe… no paṭikkamoti.
sn35.87:3.4: seyyathāpi āvuso balavā puriso daḷhena varattakkhandhena sīse sīsaveṭhaṃ dadeyya evameva kho āvuso adhimattā vātā sīse sīsavedanā.
sn35.87:3.5: na me āvuso khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ …pe… no paṭikkamoti.
sn35.87:3.6: seyyathāpi āvuso dakkho goghātako vā goghātakantevāsī vā tiṇhena govikantanena kucchiṃ parikanteyya evameva kho me āvuso adhimattā vātā kucchiṃ parikantanti.
sn35.87:3.7: na me āvuso khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ …pe… no paṭikkamoti.
sn35.87:3.8: seyyathāpi āvuso dve balavanto purisā dubbalataraṃ purisaṃ nānā bāhāsu gahetvā aṅgārakāsuyā santāpeyyuṃ saṃparitāpeyyuṃ evameva kho me āvuso adhimatto kāyasmiṃ ḍāho.
sn35.87:3.9: na me āvuso khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamoti.
sn35.87:3.10: satthaṃ āvuso sārīputta āharissāmi nāvakaṅkhāmi jīvitanti
sn35.87:4.2: yāpetāyasmā channo yāpentaṃ mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ channaṃ icchāma
sn35.87:4.3: sace āyasmato channassa natthi sappāyāni bhojanāni ahaṃ āyasmato channassa sappāyāni bhojanāni pariyesissāmi
sn35.87:4.4: sace āyasmato channassa natthi sappāyāni bhesajjāni ahaṃ āyasmato channassa sappāyāni bhesajjāni pariyesissāmi
sn35.87:4.5: sace āyasmato channassa natthi paṭirūpā upaṭṭhākā ahaṃ āyasmantaṃ channaṃ upaṭṭhahissāmi
sn35.87:4.6: mā ca āyasmā channo satthaṃ āharesi
sn35.87:4.7: yāpetāyasmā channo yāpentaṃ mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ channaṃ icchāmāti.
sn35.87:5.1: na me āvuso sārīputta natthi sappāyāni bhojanāni
sn35.87:5.7: api ca me āvuso satthā pariciṇṇo dīgharattaṃ manāpeneva no amanāpena.
sn35.87:5.8: etaṃ hi āvuso sāvakassa paṭirūpaṃ yaṃ satthāraṃ paricareyya manāpeneva no amanāpena taṃ
sn35.87:5.9: anupavajjaṃ channo bhikkhu satthaṃ āharissatīti evametaṃ āvuso sārīputta dhārehīti.
sn35.87:6.1: puccheyyāma mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ channaṃ kiñcideva desaṃ sace āyasmā channo okāsaṃ karoti pañhassa veyyākaraṇāyāti.
sn35.87:7.1: cakkhuṃ āvuso channa cakkhuviññāṇaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti samanupassasi …pe…
sn35.87:7.2: jivhaṃ āvuso channa jivhāviññāṇaṃ jivhāviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti samanupassasi …pe…

sn35.87:8.1: cakkhuṃ āvuso sārīputta cakkhuviññāṇaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti samanupassāmi …pe…
sn35.87:8.2: jivhaṃ āvuso sārīputta jivhāviññāṇaṃ jivhāviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme netaṃ mama nesohamasmi …pe…
sn35.87:8.3: manaṃ āvuso sārīputta manoviññāṇaṃ manoviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti samanupassāmīti.
sn35.87:9.1: cakkhusmiṃ āvuso channa cakkhuviññāṇe cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbesu dhammesu kiṃ disvā kiṃ abhiññāya cakkhuṃ cakkhuviññāṇaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti samanupassasi …pe…
sn35.87:9.2: jivhāya āvuso channa jivhāviññāṇe jivhāviññāṇaviññātabbesu dhammesu kiṃ disvā kiṃ abhiññāya jivhaṃ jivhāviññāṇaṃ jivhāviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti samanupassasi …pe…
sn35.87:9.3: manasmiṃ āvuso channa manoviññāṇe manoviññāṇaviññātabbesu dhammesu kiṃ disvā kiṃ abhiññāya manaṃ manoviññāṇaṃ manoviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti samanupassasīti.
sn35.87:10.1: cakkhusmiṃ āvuso sārīputta cakkhuviññāṇe cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbesu dhammesu nirodhaṃ disvā nirodhaṃ abhiññāya cakkhuṃ cakkhuviññāṇaṃ cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti samanupassāmi …pe…
sn35.87:10.2: jivhāya āvuso sārīputta jivhāviññāṇe jivhāviññāṇaviññātabbesu dhammesu nirodhaṃ disvā nirodhaṃ abhiññāya jivhaṃ jivhāviññāṇaṃ jivhāviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti samanupassāmi …pe…
sn35.87:10.3: manasmiṃ āvuso sārīputta manoviññāṇe manoviññāṇaviññātabbesu dhammesu nirodhaṃ disvā nirodhaṃ abhiññāya manaṃ manoviññāṇaṃ manoviññāṇaviññātabbe dhamme netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti samanupassāmīti.
sn35.87:11.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā mahācundo āyasmantaṃ channaṃ etadavoca
sn35.87:11.2: tasmā tihāvuso channa idampi tassa bhagavato sāsanaṃ niccakappaṃ sādhukaṃ manasikātabbaṃ
sn35.87:11.8: cutūpapāte asati nevidha na huraṃ na ubhayamantarena
sn35.87:12.1: atha kho āyasmā ca sārīputto āyasmā ca mahācundo āyasmantaṃ channaṃ iminā ovādena ovaditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkamiṃsu.
sn35.87:12.2: atha kho āyasmā channo acirapakkantesu tesu āyasmantesu satthaṃ āharesi.
sn35.87:13.1: atha kho āyasmā sārīputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sārīputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn35.87:13.4: nanu te sārīputta channena bhikkhunā sammukhāyeva anupavajjatā byākatāti.
sn35.87:13.7: honti hete sārīputta channassa bhikkhuno mittakulāni suhajjakulāni upavajjakulānīti.
sn35.87:13.8: na kho panāhaṃ sārīputta ettāvatā saupavajjoti vadāmi.
sn35.87:13.9: yo kho sārīputta imañca kāyaṃ nikkhipati aññañca kāyaṃ upādiyati tamahaṃ saupavajjoti vadāmi.
